notes.title: Winter Wonderland Update + New Game Mode
notes.notes:
[i][b]Evoke is getting festive![/b][/i]

We've been working really [b]hard[/b] to get you an update before the end of [i][b]2018![/b][/i]

As promised we have given you a [b]new game mode[/b] to try out! [b][i]Infinite mode[/i][/b] will force you to use all of your [b]spells[/b] to survive and score as many points as possible! Don't forget to [i][b]tweet[/b][/i] us your high scores! [i][b]@polyflame[/b][/i]

While here in [b]Australia[/b] we are in the sweltering heat of summer! We can virtually cool off in a [b][i]snow covered[/i][/b] Greyhelm Forest! Check it out yourself before all the [b]snow melts![/b]


[b]Happy Holidays!  See you all in 2019 <3[/b]

[b][i]- Polyflame[/i][/b]

notes.title: Available Now!
notes.notes:
[i][b]Welcome to Evoke![/b][/i]

We are [i]super excited[/i] for you to try your hand at [b]wizarding![/b] We are a small Australian dev team and we want your experience to be [b]wand[/b][i]-erful[/i]!

However if something does go wrong while playing feel free to email us at: [u][b]polyflamestudios@gmail.com[/b][/u]

Let us know the details of your issue and we will do our best to get it fixed ASAP!

[b]Stay tuned for more <3[/b]

[i][b]- Polyflame [/b][/i]
